title: Bridge checklist: product lead ↔ engineer — quick journal
content:
Meeting: weekly PM ↔ Eng lead sync (short format)
Date/Time: 2026-03-12 10:00–10:30 PT (reserve)
Attendees: Leah (PM), Arjun Malik (Eng Lead) — note: Arjun asked for 25 min agenda, 5 min action sync
Primary goals for this 1:1: align on near-term decisions that unblock API/Console feature rollouts and Dedicated capacity pricing; surface any escalations for Private onboarding customers

Agenda (priority order)
1) Quick wins and blockers (5–7 min)
   - Status: API route-level tracing landed in staging; see PR #2093 — need Eng to confirm cost overhead estimate for prod tagging.
   - Console metrics widget: UX flagged missing token-cost breakdown for embeddings — PM request to add a quick drilldown.
   - Dedicated autoscale bug: recent regression causing slow upscales at 95% utilization (SRE ticket JIRA-4827).

2) Routing/fallback policy decision (8–10 min)
   - Tradeoff: prefer model-variant fallback (smaller quantized) vs region fallback to preserve latency SLOs for enterprise tier.
   - Data: Canary run shows 7% tail-latency hit when using region fallback; model-variant fallback adds 12% variance in quality for small prompt sets.
   - Decision asked of Eng lead: recommend which approach to lock for next 3-week rollout window or propose hybrid.

3) Dedicated pricing & capacity commitments (5 min)
   - Commercial asked for a 6-mo commit SKU with burst capacity; need Eng input on what a safe burst multiplier is without compromising other customers.
   - Action: Leah to draft proposed SKU; Arjun to validate capacity safety margin before EOD Friday.

4) Private deployment onboarding checklist (3 min)
   - Customer X requires HSM + air-gap install — Ops package currently missing a final-runbook for customer-managed KMS key rotation.
   - Ask: Arjun to point to a runbook or delegate to Solutions Eng.

Notes & snippets (freeform)
- Quick note: When discussing routing, reference the "latency vs cost" dashboard under Console -> Observability -> Model Routing. Will paste link in thread.
- Eng suggested experimenting with a small (5%) canary that forces model-variant fallback and logs quality deltas on a prompt set of 300 queries; acceptable to run for 48–72h.
- If we go hybrid: prefer region fallback for tail-latency incidents and model-variant fallback for short, predictable degradation windows.

Open questions to resolve in meeting or follow-up
- What is the safe burst multiplier for Dedicated that keeps latency SLOs for other reserved customers? (ask SRE/capacity accounting)
- Who owns the KMS rotation instructions for Private: Solutions Eng or Infra?
- Can we attach a cost-estimate to the routing fallback policy choice (expected tokens / added infra cost)?

Action items (owner — due)
- Arjun — validate Dedicated burst multiplier range and provide a recommended default (due 2026-03-13).
- Leah — draft 6-mo commit SKU & pricing hypothesis and share with Sales for initial feedback (due 2026-03-14).
- Rajiv (SRE) — triage JIRA-4827 and propose a mitigation (due 2026-03-15).
- Arjun — point to KMS/runbook owner or flag as handoff to Solutions Eng (due 2026-03-16).
- Leah — run a short analysis tying routing fallback choices to per-token cost delta; attach sample prompts (due 2026-03-18).

Parking lot / future topics (quick bullets)
- Draft wording for Console UX to show "predicted cost impact" when changing model variant or quantization profile.
- Consider a small experiment to let Dedicated customers opt into "burst mode" with price premium.
- Follow-up on canary quality eval tooling — need a standardized eval harness for prompt sets.

Prep notes for Leah (things to bring up explicitly)
- Emphasize the Sales ask for a SKU that is both clear and easy to explain to legal/cost teams — we should avoid multi-tiered complex options in the first pass.
- Confirm that SRE mitigation is acceptable as an interim fix before full Dedicated autoscale rewrite.
- Ask Eng to estimate total engineering weeks needed to add the KMS rotation runbook to Private on-prem package.

Tone & signals to watch from Arjun
- If he pushes back on locking a single fallback strategy, solicit a short technical proposal with measurable success criteria and schedule.
- If Arjun flags staffing needs as the main blocker, note which roles and be prepared to escalate to hiring plan.

Post-meeting follow-up template (to send as thread)
- Quick TL;DR with decisions made + link to notes.
- List of action items with owners + due dates.
- Links to supporting artifacts (PRs, dashboards, Jira).

Draft Message (after meeting)
"Thanks Arjun — good sync. Quick summary: we agreed to run a 48h model-variant fallback canary (5%) to collect quality delta; you will validate Dedicated burst multiplier and Rajiv will triage the autoscale regression. Action items below. I'll open a short Confluence page to capture the decision and link the canary results. — Leah"

Quick reference (links to paste into thread)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-runtime/pull/2093
- Jira: JIRA-4827 (Dedicated autoscale regression)
- Confluence: model-routing-playbook (will create page after meeting)

Personal ticklist (pre-meeting)
- [ ] Pull latest canary latency numbers (Observability)
- [ ] Screenshot of Console metrics widget gap
- [ ] Draft SKU sketch for Sales
- [ ] Confirm Arjun's preferred timebox (25 min ok?)

End of quick journal.

---
Small private note to self: keep this lean — 1:1 is to unblock decisions, not to re-hash detailed design. If technical depth is required, schedule a follow-up deep-dive with Eng + SRE + Solutions Eng.
